messages:
deploy-bot: INITIATING blue-green shift for service=router-api release=v2.13.4 window=2h change-window=2026-03-21T22:00Z->2026-03-22T00:00Z. plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% in 10m steps. runbook: https://runbook.internal/bluegreen-router-api

maria: heads-up — this contains the kv-cache fix we validated in staging. tagging release now, QA passed smoke and perf quickchecks.

sam: @ops-oncall confirm LB change path: will we flip weights at the LB layer or use router-cohort routing? we need session affinity (cookie) held for 10m.

jia: rollback criterion proposal: pin fallback to v2.13.3 if p95 latency > 220ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR 5xx rate > 2% sustained for 2 minutes. also abort if redis-miss rate > 8%.

ops-oncall: watching metrics: backend-p95, 5xx%, queue-depth, redis-miss. alert thresholds I want on watch: p95>250ms, 5xx>3%, queue depth > 2000. will post live updates.

ben: note — kv warmup can take ~4m for EU regions. suggest gating progression past 20% until warmup metric (kv_cache_hit_rate > 90%) stabilizes.

deploy-bot: STEP 1 -> shifting 5% -> 20% now. progress: 20% applied.

kyle: quick smoke in eu-west is clean. no user-facing errors seen. logs: minor retry noise but tgtd. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: STEP 2 -> attempting 50% after warmup check. running warmup probe:
```
curl -sS "https://orchestrator.internal/api/v1/traffic-shift" \
  -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"service":"router-api","target_percent":50,"mode":"gradual"}'
```

release-notes-bot: Release notes published -> https://docs.internal/releases/v2.13.4 (includes kv-cache fix, session-affinity toggle, observability knobs)

sam: pinning plan: /cds pin router-api v2.13.4 once we hit 50% and smoke looks good. if we see the rollback criteria hit, I'll execute rollback cmd.

ops-oncall: current signals: p95=210ms, 5xx=0.3%, redis-miss=2.1%, kv_cache_hit_rate=94% — proceed to 100% in next step. rollback trigger: p95>240ms for 2m -> immediate rollback.

maria: rollback instructions in case: notify #incidents, then run: `/deploy rollback router-api --to v2.13.3 --reason "latency spike"` and pin to v2.13.3 until ops confirms healthy.

deploy-bot: FINAL STEP -> shift to 100% complete. post-checks: smoke=pass, e2e=pass, error-rate nominal. Deployment complete at 2026-03-21T22:32:15Z. :party:

maria: annotate changelog and close INC-4521, also add note to dedicated runbook about the kv warmup gating. thanks all.
